SeasonTracker.Title: Season Tracker
SeasonTracker.Ep1Reaction: The Director reacts to the outcome (optional).
SeasonTracker.Ep2Reaction: The Director reacts; if the rating is less than 2, they may issue a warning.
SeasonTracker.Ep3Reaction: The Director reacts; if the rating is 6, all players gain 1 Rerun Point. If the rating is 0 or less, the Director freaks out and all players may level up.
SeasonTracker.Ep4Reaction: The Director reacts; if the rating is less than 4, they may issue another warning.
SeasonTracker.Ep5Reaction: The Director reacts; if the rating is 10, all players gain 1 Rerun Point. If the rating is 4 or less, the Director issues an ultimatum.
SeasonTracker.Ep6Reaction: The Director reacts; the season is over. A perfect rating of 12 earns a medal of valorous service. If playing another season, another Level Up session happens here.
SeasonTracker.GrantRerun: Grant +1 Rerun Point to the Party
SeasonTracker.GrantLevelUp: Grant a Level Up to the Party
SeasonTracker.VillainWarning: The Director has noticed 3 or more active Villains and is not happy.
